pages.text:
“Look, Daddy!
Pearl Castle!”
pages.background_theme: full scene

pages.text:
The plane landed at Sky Lagoon.
Pearl Castle was close by.
pages.background_theme: Exact owner-directed demo ground landing on wheels beside slide/swings; preserve original source frame.

pages.text:
“Let’s look inside,
Daddy,” said Roshan.
pages.background_theme: Existing Grok frame at4seconds: Roshan and Daddy at open doors, dirty interior visible. Full-art left-anchored trim preserves both characters and the threshold; no generated wall pixels.

pages.text:
Inside, dust covered the floor.
“Let’s clean it together!”
said Roshan.
pages.background_theme: dirty castle interior

pages.text:
Sniff, sniff!
Someone was sniffling behind a big shell door.
“Hello?” said Roshan.
pages.background_theme: One tiny listening little puff echoes the quiet plea; closed books suggest the dusty attic. No Grand Puff in the banks.

pages.text:
Daddy gave her a brush and some sponges.
“One little job at a time,” said Daddy.
pages.background_theme: Eager bunny peeks from supply basket; bath accessories remain ready without duplicating main brush/sponge.
pages.bounds_note: Final native visible-subject annotation; exact hidden occlusion/shadow opacity not measurable for generated pixels.

pages.text:
A dust bunny splashed in the dirty bath.
It loved to play. Splash, splash!
pages.background_theme: full scene

pages.text:
Round and round went the sponge.
Roshan wiped the sink clean.
pages.background_theme: Little bunny enjoys clean reflection, with folded towel and soap dish grounding the sink-clean moment.
pages.bounds_note: Final native visible-subject annotation; exact hidden occlusion/shadow opacity not measurable for generated pixels.

pages.text:
Out went the dirty bath water.
Roshan scrubbed the tub. Scrub, scrub!
pages.background_theme: One gentle bunny nudges duck; bath plug and rolled towel show emptied bath and cleaning context.
pages.bounds_note: Final native visible-subject annotation; exact hidden occlusion/shadow opacity not measurable for generated pixels.

pages.text:
Clean water filled the bath.
The dust bunny was ready to play!
pages.background_theme: full scene

pages.text:
Rumi was stuck under the gunk.
She needed help!
pages.background_theme: full scene

pages.text:
“I’ll help!” said Roshan.
Scoop, scoop!
pages.background_theme: Actual pool rubbish: torn star wrapper left; algae-covered dented can and discarded blue cap right. Replaces clean accessories and empty basket.
pages.bounds_note: Final regenerated native background bounds; visual design preservation, not pixel-exact extraction.

pages.text:
Rainbow colors
peeked through the gunk.
pages.background_theme: Exact restored source: rainbow colors emerge while gunk still hides the remaining bands. No ordinary-aqua replacement and no stream count.

pages.text:
Whoosh! The waterfall turned rainbow!
The swimming pool was magic!
It made the water rainbow-colored.
pages.background_theme: full scene
pages.focal_review_note: Native proof: rainbow waterfall including shell fixture occupies this central left zone; opening exclamation uses upper architecture and remaining explanation lower water, avoiding the rainbow.

pages.text:
A cup was stuck in the fountain.
Roshan pulled it free. Whoosh!
pages.background_theme: full scene

pages.text:
The gunk was gone. Up came Rumi!
She had lived in Pearl Castle for hundreds of years.
Now she was free!
pages.background_theme: full scene

pages.text:
“You helped me!”
said Rumi.
She gave Roshan
a great big hug.
pages.background_theme: Tiny working seahorse recalls freed fountain; one warm bunny and shell cup support Rumi's hug.

pages.text:
Chirp, chirp!
“Someone in the playroom
needs help!” said Roshan.
pages.background_theme: full scene

pages.text:
Two dust bunnies sat on Baby Eagle.
They wanted to play, but he was stuck.
“I’ll help!” said Roshan.
pages.background_theme: stuffie rescue

She gently brushed one bunny away,
then the other.
pages.background_theme: stuffie rescue
pages.focal_review_note: V26 native page inspection: lowest character feet end aroundy85pt;80pt exclusion retains5pt clearance. Former55pt whole-scene band included blank floor.

Baby Eagle was free!
“Let’s play gently,” said Roshan.
pages.background_theme: Two small sheepish bunnies remain secondary speakers; displaced toys explain their rough play.

In the art room, Roshan put
the paints in their places.
Then she scrubbed the table. Scrub, scrub!

pages.bounds_note: Final regenerated native background bounds; visual design preservation, not pixel-exact extraction.

pages.text:
Only the big shell door was still shut.
Behind it, someone sneezed... AH-CHOO!
pages.background_theme: The same final shell door is shadowed violet with a narrow uncertain seam glow. Correct completed room doors and converging route paths remain, but there is no rainbow welcome; Roshan looks cautiously curious.

pages.text:
Grand Puff!
He was covered in dust.
He did not feel well.
pages.background_theme: Two little puffs look gently unwell beside a pop-up tissue box and their existing water flask; Grand Puff remains foreground only.

pages.text:
“Hold on, we’ll make you feel
clean and better!” said Roshan.

pages.bounds_note: Final native visible-subject annotation; exact hidden occlusion/shadow opacity not measurable for generated pixels.

pages.text:
Daddy, Rumi, and Baby Eagle helped Roshan.
Together, they washed Grand Puff. Scrub, scrub!
pages.background_theme: full scene

pages.text:
Soft bubbles covered Grand Puff.
Little colors began to shine beneath them.
pages.background_theme: full scene

pages.text:
POP! Grand Puff sprang out, rainbow bright!
The dust fell away.
pages.background_theme: full scene

pages.text:
Down came Grand Puff, soft and small.
He felt like himself again.
pages.background_theme: full scene

pages.text:
The art room was tidy.
One little job at a time,
Pearl Castle was clean again.

pages.text:
“We helped your rainbow shine!” said Roshan.
“Thank you!” said Grand Puff.
Roshan smiled. “Come and rest with us!”

There was room for everyone.
They curled up and fell asleep.
